axes.model_access: The Doubao consumer app runs ByteDance’s Seed family: the official Seed 2.1 release names Pro and Turbo tiers with 1M context and multimodal understanding, and explicitly points to the “office task” mode on Doubao PC or the Doubao app; the Volcengine Ark model list carries `doubao-seed-2-1-pro-260915` / `doubao-seed-2-1-lite-260915` with 1024K context, multimodality, GUI and tool calling, plus the weekly `doubao-seed-evolving`. In-app tiers follow the signed-in interface (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web at doubao.com, iOS/Android apps, the PC client and the Doubao Work desktop app; generation runs in ByteDance’s cloud with no local model. Enterprise model APIs are a separate Volcengine Ark line (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Uploaded documents, images, recordings and generated files live account-side; the privacy policy states that PPT/writing outputs are saved automatically to cloud drive, as are recording transcripts, original text and audio, with documents managed in cloud drive and downloads landing locally (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Conversations stream; the office-task mode can plan multiple steps within a session and produce documents, spreadsheets, PPTs and web pages as a foreground task, not an offline queue that resumes after shutdown. Recording transcription and meeting notes are processed in the cloud and saved to cloud drive (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: Text/voice/image/file chat, web search, document parsing, PPT and writing, spreadsheet handling, image and video generation, translation and simultaneous interpretation, recording transcription, screen sharing/video calls, coding and app publishing, and memory; the desktop app can also operate a virtual desktop and browser and edit documents/PPT/web pages in place (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Memory is on by default: it distils interests, preferences and habits from conversations into background for later replies, with a switch under Settings → Memory, per-item review/deletion, a “delete all” action, and in-chat remember/forget commands. Memory is shared across devices on one account but isolated between accounts and agents; turning the switch off stops new memories and their use without deleting existing ones (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: Account plus free and paid plans; §1.10 of the personal-edition privacy policy allows inputs, instructions and replies to be analysed and used for model training after encryption, de-identification and non-reidentification, with an opt-out under Settings → Privacy & Permissions → Help improve the model in the app or Settings → Help improve the model on PC/web. Memory and cloud drive are managed separately, and the API line follows Volcengine’s separate agreement (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: Chinese everyday Q&A and office output, integrated memory and cloud drive, synced app/PC/web, recording transcription and interpretation. Not fit: local models, free model switching or contract-grade API data terms (use Volcengine Ark) (2026-11-21).
